name: ship-secrets-port
note: ship.mjs ship(): manifestText runtime loam, validate(parse()), render, topKustomization

planter.appYaml:
# What p6-logs needs from the platform. Its build renders k8s/platform/ from this on every build of
# main (arugula-salad/planter, platform-app/render.mjs, says what each key gives).
name: p6-logs
port: 3000
health: /healthz
# On loam, at https://p6-logs.run.inevitable.fyi: asleep until a request wakes it. Moving it into the
# cluster is changing this to k8s (with its domain), in a pull request a person merges.
runtime: loam
env: { port: APP_PORT }
needs:
  domain: [p6-logs.run.inevitable.fyi]
  secrets: [STRIPE_KEY, OTHER]
  telemetry: logs

files.k8s/platform/deployment.yaml:
# Generated from app.yaml by arugula-salad/planter's platform-app (the app, on loam). Don't edit: the next
# build of main renders it again. Change app.yaml, or patch it from k8s/kustomization.yaml.
# p6-logs runs on loam, at https://p6-logs.run.inevitable.fyi, not here: this Deployment has no replicas. It is the
# record home-cloud's loam provisioner (apps/apps-platform) reads: the pinned image, the port, the
# health path and the secrets, from which it makes the app's sandbox in loam project apps and runs
# the image's program in it as a service, replacing the sandbox whenever the image changes.
# Promoting the app to the cluster is changing app.yaml's runtime to k8s, in a pull request a person merges.
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: p6-logs
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: p6-logs
    platform.arugula.io/runtime: loam
  annotations:
    platform.arugula.io/loam-port: "3000"
    platform.arugula.io/loam-port-env: APP_PORT
    platform.arugula.io/loam-health: /healthz
    # Infisical `planter-apps-md-qs` / prod / `/p6-logs`, given to the sandbox as env when it is made.
    platform.arugula.io/loam-secrets: "STRIPE_KEY,OTHER"
spec:
  replicas: 0
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: p6-logs
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: p6-logs
    spec:
      imagePullSecrets:
        - name: ghcr
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: p6-logs
          image: ghcr.io/arugula-salad/p6-logs
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities:
              drop: [ALL]
files.k8s/platform/kustomization.yaml:
# Generated from app.yaml by arugula-salad/planter's platform-app (the list of what it renders). Don't edit: the next
# build of main renders it again. Change app.yaml, or patch it from k8s/kustomization.yaml.
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - deployment.yaml
  - dashboard.yaml

planter.top:
# https://p6-logs.run.inevitable.fyi: p6-logs on home-cloud, applied by Flux from this directory. platform/ is rendered
# from app.yaml on every build of main (don't edit it); this file is yours: add kustomize patches here
# for anything app.yaml can't say. Every app shares the `planter-apps` namespace, which the platform
# owns along with the `ghcr` pull secret and the `planter-apps-secrets` ServiceAccount.
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
namespace: planter-apps
resources:
  - platform
images:
  - name: ghcr.io/arugula-salad/p6-logs
    # Pinned by .github/workflows/build.yml on every build of main. `unpinned` is a placeholder
    # that does not exist: the app does not run until CI has replaced it.
    newTag: unpinned
